title: R&D IC Engineer 3
description:
Overview:

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.

Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

**Job Description**

We are looking for a hands-on FPGA Engineer to design and develop FPGA solutions for next-generation CXL and PCIe Gen6/Gen7 protocol test products. The engineer will work closely with FPGA architects, hardware, software, validation, and system teams to implement, integrate, debug, and validate FPGA functionality.

  
Responsibilities:

* Design and implement FPGA logic for CXL and PCIe Gen6/Gen7 protocol solutions.
* Translate protocol and product requirements into RTL design and implementation.
* Develop and maintain RTL using Verilog and/or VHDL.
* Work with Intel/Altera and/or AMD/Xilinx FPGA tools and design flows.
* Perform functional simulation, synthesis, implementation, timing analysis, and FPGA debug.
* Work closely with hardware and software teams for FPGA integration and platform bring-up.
* Debug protocol, hardware, FPGA, and system-level issues.
* Participate in validation, performance optimization, and product qualification.
* Contribute to reusable and maintainable FPGA components and verification practices.
* Use AI/ML and AI-assisted engineering tools to improve productivity, RTL development, verification, debugging, documentation, and automation.
* Collaborate effectively with cross-functional and global engineering teams.

Qualifications:

**Essential**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or related field.
* 5+ years of FPGA design and development experience.
* Strong hands-on experience with RTL design using Verilog and/or VHDL.
* Good understanding of FPGA architecture, digital design, simulation, synthesis, and timing.
* Experience with FPGA development tools from Intel/Altera and/or AMD/Xilinx.
* Ability to debug FPGA designs and work with hardware/software integration.
* Strong problem-solving and communication skills.
* Ability to quickly learn new protocols and technologies.

**Preferred**

* Strong knowledge of CXL and/or PCIe protocols.
* Experience with PCIe Gen5/Gen6/Gen7 or other high-speed interconnect technologies.
* Experience with protocol analyzers, exercisers, or validation platforms.
* Experience with FPGA-based high-speed test systems.
* Experience with hardware bring-up and lab debugging.
* Experience using AI/ML or GenAI tools to improve engineering productivity and automation.

Careers Privacy Statement\*\*\*Keysight is an Equal Opportunity Employer.\*\*\*

title: Architect
description:

title: Estimation Engineer (Civil)
description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented **Construction Estimator** with experience in **construction estimation, quantity take-offs, BOQ preparation, pricing, and project cost estimation**. The candidate will be responsible for reviewing **2D drawings and blueprints**, preparing accurate quantities and pricing, and delivering fast-paced estimates for US-based construction projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Cost Estimation:** Prepare detailed quantity take-offs, cost estimates, budgets, and bids for civil construction projects. Determine costs for labor, materials, equipment, subcontractors, and other project-related expenses.
* **Drawing & Plan Analysis:** Identify discrepancies, missing information, scope changes, design variations, and inconsistencies in drawings, specifications, and BOQs, and coordinate for necessary clarifications..
* **Quantity Take-Off:** Perform accurate quantity take-offs and quantity surveys for materials, labor, equipment, and other construction activities based on drawings and project specifications.
* **Construction Estimating:** Prepare fast, accurate, and detailed construction estimates primarily based on 2D drawings, blueprints, specifications, and project requirements.
* **Pricing & Budgeting:** Prepare detailed cost estimates, pricing estimates, BOQs, and project budgets covering materials, labor, equipment, subcontractors, and other project expenses.
* **Vendor & Subcontractor Management:** Solicit, evaluate, compare, and manage quotations from subcontractors, suppliers, and vendors to ensure competitive and accurate pricing.
* **Estimate Comparison:** Review and compare estimates, quotations, and pricing to identify cost differences, discrepancies, and opportunities for cost optimization.
* **Collaboration:** Coordinate with engineers, architects, project managers, internal teams, clients, vendors, and subcontractors to clarify drawings, quantities, specifications, scope, and pricing.
* **Reporting:** Prepare and present detailed cost reports, proposals, bid summaries, budget updates, estimate comparisons, and other estimation-related documentation.
* **Database Management:** Maintain accurate cost databases, estimation sheets, supplier and subcontractor databases, BOQs, historical pricing, and supporting documentation.
* **Software Proficiency:** Utilize estimating and construction software and tools, including **Bluebeam, PlanSwift, On-Screen Takeoff, MS Office, and ERP systems**, for quantity take-offs, estimation, pricing, and reporting.
* **Construction Knowledge:** Demonstrate a strong understanding of construction materials, labor costing, equipment costs, subcontractor pricing, and overall project expenses.
* **Turnaround & Accuracy:** Ensure all estimates, bids, quantity take-offs, and related deliverables are completed within the required **TAT (Turnaround Time)** while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor s degree in civil engineering, Construction Management, or related field
* **Experience:** Proven experience in construction estimating, project management, or related roles with minimum 4-5 years of experience (US/Canada projects preferred).
* **Skills:** Strong analytical, mathematical, communication, and problem-solving skills

Work Location: In person

title: Solution Engineering - Apps & AI
description:
**Overview**

Work with multinational enterprise customers to achieve their business goals using Azure as their platform of choice. Open doors, become a trusted technical adviser, uncover opportunities and turn their ambitions into practical solutions that deliver business value.

Combine an enterprise-architecture mindset and broad cloud understanding with strong, hands-on Apps and AI expertise. You do not need to be the deepest expert in every Azure service; know how a complete solution fits together and when to involve specialists and subject matter experts.

This role offers autonomy and influence across customer organisations. Own the technical direction of complex opportunities, align teams when priorities are unclear and take responsibility for achieving agreed technical outcomes. Work from executive conversations to practical demonstrations, challenging assumptions constructively and drawing on account teams, specialists and partners.

 **Responsibilities**  

### **Technical Sales Leadership**

* Proactively build customer access, discover unmet needs across Azure and create new technical opportunities that deliver business value.
* Independently lead complex engagements spanning multiple technologies, teams and customer locations. Align stakeholders, resolve competing priorities and drive technical decisions through discovery, workshops and demonstrations.

### **Application Modernization**

* Help customers modernise applications using Azure and cloud-native approaches, balancing existing investments with future business needs.
* Guide modern software delivery and developer productivity, including GitHub and GitHub Copilot, to accelerate innovation.

### **AI & Intelligent Applications**

* Shape intelligent applications and agent solutions using Microsoft Foundry, Copilot technologies and enterprise data, including Microsoft Fabric where relevant.
* Build focused prototypes and demonstrations to test customer ideas, show value and guide secure, responsible AI adoption.

### **Solution Design & Architecture**

* Take an end-to-end view across Azure infrastructure, networking, identity, security, data, applications and AI, including hybrid environments.
* Adapt and extend architecture patterns for complex customer requirements. Make clear recommendations on trade-offs between business value, security, reliability and cost, and develop practical roadmaps rather than isolated product designs.
* Work with specialists, customer success and partners to help customers progress from architecture to adoption.

### **Customer & Market Engagement**

* Build trusted relationships from developers and architects to Heads of Development and VPs; listen, challenge constructively and build consensus across technical and business stakeholders.
* Understand customer priorities, programmes and decision-makers, aligning technical engagement with their wider business and transformation strategy.

### **Sales & Business Impact**

* Use business and commercial judgement to connect technical choices to customer outcomes and differentiated Microsoft value, building a clear case for investment.
* Qualify technical opportunities around clear customer needs and business value, and agree meaningful next steps.
* Shape the strategy for winning and growing opportunities with account teams, using customer and competitive insight to guide investment decisions and overcome technical barriers.

### **Team & Community Contribution**

* Lead collaboration across teams and coach technical colleagues and account teams. Create reusable architectures and approaches from customer engagements, and help others apply them to improve outcomes beyond your own opportunities.
* Maintain hands-on learning, relevant skills and certifications, and demonstrate inclusion, integrity and customer focus.

  
**Qualifications**  

### **Minimum Qualifications**

Meet one of the following alternatives:

* Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 4+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience;
* OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 6+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience;
* OR 7+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience;
* OR equivalent experience.

### **Technical Experience**

* Proven experience across technical selling and delivery, leading complex opportunities across multiple technologies and teams from discovery to practical validation. Evidence of sound architectural decisions when requirements are unclear and influence beyond your own work.
* Strong understanding of Azure, enterprise architecture and how infrastructure, security, data, applications and AI work together.
* Hands-on application development and AI capability, including building prototypes and explaining technical choices to customers.
* Experience with modern software delivery and developer productivity, using Microsoft technologies or comparable platforms.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication and commercial judgement, with the ability to work independently from practitioner to executive level and navigate ambiguity across organisational boundaries.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* 8+ years technical pre-sales, technical consulting, or technology delivery, or related experience OR equivalent experience.
* 6+ years experience with cloud and hybrid, or on premises infrastructures, architecture designs, migrations, industry standards, and/or technology management.
* Experience with enterprise modernization, AI solutions or multinational customer engagements, including Azure, Microsoft Foundry, Microsoft Fabric or GitHub.
* Relevant cloud, AI, development, architecture or security certifications.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Customers seek your advice and involve you in their technical and business priorities.
* Strong relationships reveal new technical opportunities and support customer growth.
* Complex opportunities move forward because your architecture recommendations and technical proof help customers resolve trade-offs and make confident investment decisions.
* Customers experience a coordinated Microsoft team, and colleagues reuse your architectures and approaches to achieve stronger outcomes.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

description:

We are seeking an experienced **Manager – Embedded Systems Development & Testing** to lead a high-performing engineering team responsible for the **design, development, integration, verification, and validation of embedded systems for next-generation medical devices**.

The role will provide technical and people leadership across the embedded product lifecycle, from requirements and architecture through software/hardware development, system integration, verification, validation, and product release.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in **embedded software, real-time systems, hardware/software integration, automated testing, system verification, and regulated product development**, combined with the ability to build and lead engineering teams.

**What You will do:**

Key Responsibilities

1. Engineering Leadership

* Lead and manage embedded systems development and testing teams responsible for medical device products.Define engineering strategies, development processes, technical direction, and execution plans.
* Provide technical leadership across embedded software, firmware, system integration, and verification.Drive execution of multiple concurrent projects while balancing **quality, schedule, cost, and technical risks**.
* Establish clear ownership, accountability, and engineering metrics across the team.Partner with Product Management, Systems Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Clinical, and other cross-functional teams.

2. Embedded Systems Development

* Lead development of embedded software/firmware for medical devices and connected systems.Guide architecture and design decisions involving:Embedded C/C++RTOSMicrocontrollers and SoCsDevice driversCommunication protocolsUSB/BLE/Wi-Fi/EthernetSensor interfacesMotor/control systemsPower managementBootloaders and firmware update mechanisms
* Ensure robust hardware/software integration and system-level performance.Drive reuse of software platforms, common architectures, libraries, and development frameworks across products.

3. Verification & Validation

* Lead development and execution of **unit, integration, system, and acceptance testing** strategies.Establish robust verification methodologies for embedded software and complete medical-device systems.
* Drive automated testing, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), simulation, test automation, and continuous integration where appropriate.Ensure traceability between:  
  **User Needs System Requirements Software Requirements Design Implementation Verification**
* Review and approve verification strategies, test plans, test cases, and test results.Drive root-cause analysis and resolution of complex technical issues discovered during development and testing.

4. Quality & Regulatory Compliance

* Ensure engineering activities comply with applicable medical-device development processes and organizational quality systems.Work closely with Quality and Regulatory teams to ensure compliance with applicable standards and regulations, such as:**ISO 13485IEC 62304IEC 60601**, where applicable**ISO 14971IEC 62366**, where applicableCybersecurity requirements applicable to medical devicesApplicable FDA and international regulatory requirements
* Ensure appropriate documentation, design controls, risk management, change control, and verification evidence throughout the product lifecycle.Participate in design reviews, risk reviews, audits, and regulatory submissions as required.

5. Test Automation & Engineering Excellence

* Establish a modern automated testing strategy for embedded products.Increase automated test coverage and reduce dependence on manual testing.
* Promote:CI/CD for embedded systemsAutomated regression testingHardware-in-the-loop testingStatic and dynamic analysis Code coverage Unit testing Integration testing System-level testing. Establish engineering metrics to monitor product quality, test effectiveness, defect escape rates, and development efficiency.

6. Technical Problem Solving

* Act as an escalation point for complex embedded-system issues.Lead cross-functional investigation of difficult hardware/software/system failures.
* Drive structured root-cause analysis using methodologies such as **5-Why, Fishbone, FMEA, and fault-tree analysis**.Ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented effectively.Provide technical guidance during field issues, customer escalations, and product investigations.

7. People & Talent Leadership

* Build, mentor, and retain a strong embedded engineering organization.Define team structure, roles, responsibilities, and technical career paths.Conduct performance management, coaching, and regular career development discussions.
* Identify technical skill gaps and establish training and development plans.Recruit high-quality embedded software, firmware, systems, and test engineers.Develop future technical leaders and engineering managers.

8. Project & Program Execution

* Work with program/project managers to develop realistic technical schedules and resource plans.Identify technical risks early and establish mitigation plans.
* Track milestones, dependencies, defects, technical debt, and engineering deliverables.Communicate project status, risks, and opportunities to senior leadership.Support product launches and sustaining engineering activities.

**What You Need:**

Must Have

* **13-16 years** embedded systems experience with **5+ years people-management/technical leadership**.
* Strong **embedded architecture and system-design** knowledge across software, hardware, RTOS, drivers, and interfaces.
* Proven experience leading teams through **end-to-end product development** from requirements to release and sustaining.
* Strong understanding of **verification, testing, quality, risk management, and regulated product development**.
* Strong **people leadership, mentoring, cross-functional influence, and execution** skills.

Good to have

* **Medical-device / safety-critical / regulated product** development experience.
* Experience with **manufacturing/NPD, production, and sustaining engineering**.
* Hands-on knowledge of **motor control, electromechanical systems, embedded Linux, connectivity, and cybersecurity**.
* Experience with **automation, HIL, CI/CD, static analysis, and automated testing**.
* Previous experience as a **Senior Staff/Staff Engineer or Embedded Architect** before moving into people management.

**Key Responsibilities**

Pre-Sales & Client Solutioning

Translate business problems into practical AI/ML, GenAI, and Agentic AI solutions.

Present solutions and technical trade-offs to CXOs, architects, security, data, and engineering teams.

Build rapid POCs and demos to validate and de-risk solutions.

Solution Architecture & Delivery

Design scalable AI architectures using LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, vector databases, embeddings, prompt/context engineering, and knowledge graphs.

Select the right approach across classical ML, LLMs, fine-tuning, RAG, agents, or hybrid solutions.

Build and deploy solutions across AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Design APIs, data pipelines, model serving, enterprise integrations, and microservices.

Build production-grade agentic systems including tool calling, multi-agent workflows, memory, human-in-the-loop, and agent hand-offs.

Establish best practices for security, scalability, performance, observability, evaluation, reliability, and cost optimisation.

AI Engineering & Team Enablement

Stay hands-on with Python, FastAPI, AI frameworks, LLM platforms, and cloud technologies.

Guide engineering and data science teams from POC through production.

Implement AI evaluation, monitoring, guardrails, and LLMOps practices.

Train internal teams and create reusable reference architectures, accelerators, and playbooks.

Track emerging AI models, frameworks, protocols, and research and apply relevant innovations to Antino’s AI practice.

**Must-Have Skills & Experience**

5+ years in software engineering, data science, ML engineering, or solution architecture.

2+ years of hands-on experience designing and deploying GenAI/LLM solutions in production.

Strong experience building Agentic AI, including tool-calling agents, multi-agent systems, agentic RAG, memory, and orchestration.

Strong foundations in statistics, classical ML, deep learning, feature engineering, model evaluation, and time series.

Strong hands-on Python and API development, preferably FastAPI.

Experience with LLM platforms such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, AWS Bedrock, and open-weight models such as Llama, Qwen, Mistral, or DeepSeek.

Experience with frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, or Google ADK.

Experience with vector/search technologies such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Qdrant, pgvector, FAISS, Chroma, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch.

Strong knowledge of Advanced RAG, GraphRAG, hybrid search, re-ranking, query rewriting, multimodal RAG, and context engineering.

Experience with MLOps/LLMOps, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, model serving, monitoring, evaluation, and cost optimisation.

Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, databases, APIs, and secure enterprise architecture.

Strong client-facing and communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both CXOs and engineering teams.

Advanced AI Expertise

**Strong understanding of:**

Agent Design: Tool/function calling, ReAct, planning, reflection, memory, state management, HITL, failure recovery.

Multi-Agent Systems: Supervisor, hierarchical and peer-to-peer patterns, task routing and agent hand-offs.

Agent Protocols: MCP and A2A.

RAG: Hybrid search, re-ranking, GraphRAG, knowledge graphs, agentic/multimodal RAG, permission-aware retrieval.

Model Adaptation: Reasoning, long-context and multimodal models, SLMs, LoRA/QLoRA, distillation, prompting vs RAG vs fine-tuning.

Inference: vLLM/TGI, quantisation, prompt caching, model routing, latency and token-cost optimisation.

Evaluation: Ragas, DeepEval, LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, golden datasets, LLM-as-a-Judge, tracing.

AI Security & Governance: Prompt injection defence, guardrails, PII protection, OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act, and India’s DPDP Act.

**Good to Have**

Experience in IT services/consulting with global clients across the US, UK, or Middle East.

Experience with enterprise knowledge platforms, knowledge graphs, or Company Brain-style systems.

Production experience in Voice AI, Document AI, or Computer Vision.

Experience with Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, or Spark.

Domain exposure to BFSI, Healthcare, Retail, Logistics, or Manufacturing.

AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud certifications.

Open-source contributions, research papers, patents, technical blogs, or conference talks.

**About Antino**

Antino is an AI-native technology consulting company helping organisations embed intelligence into the way they operate.

600+ Engineers | 50 AI Specialists | 400 Projects Delivered | 20 Countries Served

With offices across India, the US, UK, and UAE, Antino has developed Company Brain—a governed intelligence layer connecting enterprise knowledge, people, systems, and workflows to enable smarter decisions and coordinated action.

title: Expert Senior Manager, AI Engineering
description:
What Makes Us a Great Place to Work
  
  
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on [1] Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)
  
  
Bain’s [2] AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.
  
  
The Impact You’ll Have
  
  
Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.
  
  
As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.
  
  
The Role
  
  
The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle — from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization — and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders.
  
  
You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.
  
  
Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Architect multi-component pipelines, including:
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
* Embedding generation and optimization
* Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows
* Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems
* Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment
* Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment
* Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
* Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
* Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
* Hallucination rate and factual consistency
* Relevance and precision/recall
* Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
* Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps
* Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 8-12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production
* Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders
* Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups
* Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design
* Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps
* Deep experience with:
* Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval)
* Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection)
* ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
* AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Clear ability to lead, mentor, and inspire technical teams
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

Working Model & Travel
  

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

2. https://www.bain.com/careers/work-with-us/integrated-teams/ai-insights-solutions-ais/
